name: LOreal Paris Elvive Shampoo 400ml Hyaluron 72h Moisture filling Shampoo for Dehydrated Hair
description:
L'Oréal Paris Elvive Hyaluron Moisture 72H Moisture Filling Shampoo – 400ml

Key Features:

Infused with Hyaluronic Acid – Inspired by skincare, acts as a moisture magnet for dehydrated hair.

72 Hours Hydration – Instantly coats cuticles to lock in moisture and keep hair hydrated for up to 72 hours.

Lightweight Formula – Provides deep hydration without weighing hair down.

Revitalizing Effect – Leaves hair shinier, bouncier, and 10x more hydrated.

Suitable For: Dehydrated, dry, and damaged hair.

Made in: Egypt.

Benefits:

Tackles dryness and signs of dehydration.

Helps hair look plumped, revitalized, and full of bounce.

Scientifically proven, skincare-inspired formula.

Clean, refreshed, and beautifully shiny hair.

How to Use:

Apply to wet hair.

Massage gently into scalp.

Rinse thoroughly.

For best results, follow with L’Oréal Paris Elvive Hyaluron Moisture Conditioner or Mask.

In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately and thoroughly.
